sn56.42:1.3: Normally “inspiration” (paṭibhāna) describes inspired and eloquent speech. It is not clear what this has to do with the hill, which does not appear elsewhere.
sn56.42:2.2: This is a condensed treatment of dependent origination, beginning here with ignorance.
sn56.42:2.3: Their “choices” (saṅkhārā) are driven by craving, here expressed as “taking pleasure” (abhiramanti), and lead to rebirth and the rest.
